eventMetadata.context_description: National Weather Service and AccuWeather guidance for July 17 points to mostly sunny conditions with highs in the mid-to-upper 80s amid lingering smoke and haze from regional wildfires, which can slightly suppress maximum temperatures through reduced insolation. This consensus supports trader emphasis on the 88-89°F and 86-87°F bins as the most probable outcomes, while uncertainty in exact smoke coverage and afternoon mixing leaves room for minor upside or downside revisions in the final NWS forecast update.
